headline: Good morning — Nvidia's leadership turmoil and a bond sell-off rattled markets, while the RBA's rate hike keeps pressure on Australian households and the property market.

highlights.label: Nvidia turmoil
highlights.text: Nvidia's CEO reportedly resigned, dragging chip stocks and the Nasdaq lower on Friday as US 10-year yields hit about 5.17%.

highlights.label: ASX slips
highlights.text: The ASX 200 fell 0.7% to 9,082.2 on Friday, though it still finished the week higher.

highlights.label: Vizag investment summit
highlights.text: Andhra Pradesh's CII Partnership Summit in Visakhapatnam reported 303 new MoUs, lifting claimed investment intent since mid-2024 to Rs 32.49 lakh crore.

tip.title: Take three slow breaths before big tasks
tip.body: Before your next meeting or demanding task, pause for three slow breaths, making each exhale longer than the inhale. It takes under a minute and can help settle a busy mind. Repeat it whenever you notice tension building.

quote.text: Nothing will work unless you do.
quote.author: Maya Angelou

items.title: HubSpot names co-founder Halligan as CEO
items.summary: Brian Halligan returns as HubSpot CEO from 12 November, replacing Yamini Rangan, with the company reaffirming its earlier guidance. A leadership change at a major CRM and marketing vendor matters to customers watching product direction and pricing.

items.title: Braze named a Leader in first Gartner email marketing quadrant
items.summary: Braze announced it was placed as a Leader in Gartner's inaugural Magic Quadrant for Email Marketing Platforms. This is a vendor-issued announcement, but the new report gives buyers a fresh benchmark for platform shortlists.

items.title: Adobe adds a conversational AI layer to GenStudio
items.summary: Adobe plans to bring its CX Enterprise Coworker into GenStudio to coordinate AI agents across content planning, production and activation. It reflects the push towards agent-driven marketing workflows.

items.title: Adobe and Google deepen partnership, including Gmail integration
items.summary: The expanded partnership brings leading AI models into Adobe tools and Acrobat into Google Workspace, including Gmail. Marketers should watch how it affects creative production and email workflows.

items.title: Klaviyo's AI agent builds email flows from prompts
items.summary: Klaviyo's email marketing agent reached general availability at the end of October, creating multi-message flows from text prompts. Date taken from a roundup listing; older than 48 hours.

items.title: Agentforce Coworker usage jumps 21-fold in three months
items.summary: Salesforce says Coworker has passed 185,000 users and added Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 connections, plus a $50-per-user monthly option. Several pieces are slated for general availability this month; these are company targets. Published 5 November.

items.title: Dreamforce 2026 announcements recap, including AIforce
items.summary: Salesforce introduced AIforce, a layer exposing its data and workflows to outside AI interfaces, with North American availability targeted for November. Older than 48 hours, but still the main product direction for admins to track.

items.title: Salesforce sets Q3 fiscal 2027 earnings date
items.summary: Salesforce announced the date for its third-quarter fiscal 2027 results release and webcast on 10 November. Check the release for the exact date, as it will be a key read on Agentforce demand.

items.title: Salesforce disables two connected apps over suspicious token activity
items.summary: Salesforce disabled the GoFundMe Pro and Talent Rover integrations after suspicious access token activity; Talent Rover has since been restored while GoFundMe Pro remains disabled. Admins should review connected app access.

items.title: Spring '27 release: sharing recalculation and OAuth flow changes
items.summary: A sharing recalculation change is to be enforced in January 2027, and the OAuth User-Agent and Hybrid User-Agent flows are due to be retired from 20 February 2027. Teams should plan integration updates early.

sfstatus.statusNote: Only minor performance degradations were found for 6 and 10 November; no major outage or APAC-specific incident was confirmed, and no planned maintenance was located.

items.title: Performance degradation on 10 November
items.summary: A degradation lasting about two hours was posted, later updated to add more affected instances. Third-party aggregator; instances and dates not independently confirmed, so check status.salesforce.com.

items.title: Service disruption posting updated
items.summary: Salesforce revised an incident posting, saying the impact differed from its first assessment. Timing and affected services are unclear from the aggregator listing.

items.title: RBA lifts cash rate to 4.85%, highest since 2008
items.summary: The RBA raised rates by 0.25 points on 3 November, its fifth hike this year, with the board split six to three. Major banks have been passing on the rise; this story is older than 48 hours but still shapes the week.

items.title: Albanese government under pressure amid grants row and leaks
items.summary: An ABC analysis says the government is struggling, pointing to a $6 million Marrickville Golf Club grant and weak polling. It follows damaging leaks that Albanese says will not change the Treasurer.

items.title: Microsoft outage raises questions over $3b government IT contracts
items.summary: A global outage reportedly shut roughly 200,000 public servants out of email, prompting scrutiny of single-seller deals worth about $3 billion. Senator Pocock wants procurement rules updated to strengthen sovereign capability.

items.title: Victoria Police end Sydney Swans players investigation
items.summary: Police found insufficient evidence to charge four players over an alleged August incident at a Melbourne hotel. The decision closes a high-profile Victorian investigation.

items.title: Melbourne's liveability reputation questioned after fatal stabbing
items.summary: A fatal stabbing has reignited debate about crime and safety in Melbourne. It adds to public concern about the city's reputation as a liveable place.

items.title: Retail inflation climbs to 6.09% in October
items.summary: Provisional CPI inflation for October was 6.09%, above the RBI's 6% upper limit, with food inflation at 8.94% and rural inflation at 6.63%. It adds pressure on the central bank after its recent rate rise.

items.title: Union Cabinet extends Stand-Up India and sets Rabi fertiliser subsidy
items.summary: The Cabinet approved continuing Stand-Up India to 31 March 2031, continuing the credit guarantee fund for micro units and fixing Rabi-season fertiliser subsidy rates. The decisions were reported around 11 November.

items.title: Modi to visit Philippines for ASEAN-India and East Asia summits
items.summary: The Prime Minister is due in the Philippines on 16-17 November for the ASEAN-India and East Asia Summits. The trip is a focus for India's Indo-Pacific diplomacy.

items.title: India reaches 100 chess Grandmasters
items.summary: Modi praised the milestone after Anuj Shrivatri earned the Grandmaster title on 10 November. It marks a symbolic high for Indian chess.

items.title: Amit Shah holds law-and-order review at Delhi Police HQ
items.summary: The Home Minister held a second review covering women's safety and organised crime. Details of any decisions were not found.

items.title: CII Partnership Summit in Visakhapatnam secures 303 MoUs
items.summary: The two-day summit on 12-13 November reportedly yielded 303 new MoUs with potential for about 3.48 lakh jobs, taking investment intent since June 2024 to Rs 32.49 lakh crore. These are intent figures, not completed investment.

items.title: Cabinet clears Rs 31,387-crore AI data centre near Visakhapatnam
items.summary: The state cabinet approved a 512 MW green AI data centre at Bheemunipatnam, expected to create about 1,000 jobs. It strengthens Visakhapatnam's AI infrastructure push.

items.title: Cabinet approves AVGC-XR and robotics policies
items.summary: The same meeting approved the AVGC-XR Policy 2026-31 and a Robotics and Physical AI Policy, plus semiconductor policy amendments. The moves aim to attract emerging-technology investment.

items.title: Investors arrive in Vizag as Jagan criticises state growth
items.summary: Delegates from nearly 59 countries reached Visakhapatnam for the summit while YSRCP chief Jagan Mohan Reddy criticised the state's economic performance. The exchange shows the political contest over the investment narrative.

items.title: Elections to 23 urban local bodies set for 26 November
items.summary: Polls will cover 23 urban local bodies, including four municipal corporations. They will be an early test of the ruling alliance's local support.

items.title: Nvidia slides after CEO Huang resigns
items.summary: Nvidia fell about 12% for the week, with CFO Colette Kress interim CEO, and HSBC cut its rating to Hold. Chip peers sold off too; reports on the circumstances vary, so treat details as unconfirmed.

items.title: Producer prices cooler than expected but annual rate high
items.summary: October PPI rose 0.3% on the month, under forecasts, while the annual rate was reported at 6.5%. Markets still price a likely December Fed hike.

items.title: Bond sell-off lifts 10-year yield to about 5.17%
items.summary: Treasury yields climbed after an oil-driven sell-off on Thursday. Higher yields weigh on growth and tech shares.

items.title: Weekly gain despite Friday slip
items.summary: The S&P 500 rose about 2.5% on the week, its first winning week since early October. Technology lagged on Friday.

items.title: Nvidia earnings next week; Anthropic IPO reportedly due to price
items.summary: Nvidia reports quarterly results on Tuesday with no permanent CEO named. Anthropic is reportedly expected to price its IPO next week.

items.title: ASX 200 slides on Nvidia woes and bond yields
items.summary: The index fell 64.6 points as surging US yields and weaker commodities hit growth and cyclical stocks. Eight of 11 sectors finished lower.

items.title: Materials and property lead losses
items.summary: Gold, base metals and uranium miners dragged, while real estate fell 1.34%. Utilities and telcos gained.

items.title: ASX still secures weekly gain
items.summary: Despite Friday's dip, the benchmark finished the week higher; sources put the gain between 0.19% and 0.68%. AUD/USD and futures were not found.

items.title: Financials cushion ASX as small caps and miners fall
items.summary: Banks supported the index while small caps lost 1.24% over the week. Weakness in miners remains a drag.

items.title: RBA hike at 4.85% still shapes rate-sensitive sectors
items.summary: The 3 November hike took the cash rate to its highest since 2008. Markets are watching for any further tightening.

items.title: Cotality: national home values down 1.2% in October
items.summary: Values are 6.7% below the March peak, and Melbourne fell 0.8% in the month and 7.6% over the year. Released 2 November.

items.title: Auction clearance rate hits six-year low
items.summary: Clearance rates fell to a six-year low at the start of November. Older than 48 hours but a key sentiment gauge.

items.title: Melbourne clearance rate lifts but remains weak
items.summary: Preliminary data put Melbourne at 59.1%, later reports at 51.7%, versus 65.9% a year earlier. Figures differ between releases; revised numbers are lower.

items.title: Banks pass on RBA hike to mortgage holders
items.summary: Major lenders raised variable rates after the cash rate rose to 4.85%, with CBA's changes effective 13 November. Canstar estimates about $107 extra a month on a $700,000 loan.

items.title: Auction volumes well below last year
items.summary: Melbourne auction numbers have been about 55% below 2025 levels since reserve-price transparency rules began in mid-October. Listings are at the highest for this time of year since 2019.
